title: Collaboration identity
scope: Keep a separate encrypted backup of your organization signing and research-exchange identity. Workspace recovery and witnessed-review identities are managed separately.
backupHelp: This file contains your private collaboration signing and exchange-encryption keys, encrypted with the password you choose here. Anyone with the file and password can act as this identity and decrypt its exchanged research. Keep both safe and separate from workspace backups. Losing this password makes this backup unusable.
recoveryHelp: Choose your encrypted identity backup. Recovery keeps the workspace locked and retains the identity already on this installation. Close any other Observanda instances using this installation before applying recovery.
reviewHelp: Recovery changes the collaboration identity for every workspace on this installation. It restores existing identity keys; it does not unlock a workspace, add memberships or override revoked access. Existing identities remain available under Recover collaboration identity.
downloaded: Encrypted identity backup downloaded. Store it safely with its password in a separate secure location.
confirmed: I have reviewed these fingerprints and want to use this identity on this installation.
restored: Collaboration identity recovered. Unlock your workspace when ready. Existing memberships and current research permissions still apply.
saved: Previously used identities on this installation
invalidFile: Choose a complete Observanda identity backup no larger than 24 KiB.
confirmFirst: Review and confirm the identity before continuing.
changed: The workspace changed. Reopen collaboration identity recovery.
